subject: Supplier activation: privacy & PO checklist for QuickMed pilot
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@quickmed.io>, procurement@quickmed.io
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier activation: privacy & PO checklist for QuickMed pilot

Hi Lara —

Thanks again for selecting Redwood for the QuickMed pilot. I'm kicking off supplier activation on our side so we can get to a signed PO and first test rollout next month. Below is the minimum procurement/privacy checklist we need to complete to create a vendor record and issue a PO: 

- Completed W-9 / tax form (if US entity) or equivalent
- Signed DPA or confirmation that QuickMed will accept Redwood's DPA (link below)
- Current list of subprocessors (CSV preferred) + confirmation about cross-border transfers
- Data retention / deletion policy for data processed by the pilot (retention period + deletion trigger)
- Certificate of insurance (if applicable)
- Preferred billing contact and PO remit-to / bank details
- Counterparty details for contract (full legal name, registered address, VAT/Tax ID)

If you can attach the subprocessor list and confirm whether you need Redwood to countersign a DPA, that will unblock us. Monica will own the privacy intake and Neha will handle PO/finance fields. Our target is to have a PO issued by 2027-03-01 so please flag any timing constraints.

Attachments: PO-Template.xlsx (blank template we use), Redwood-DPA-link (see related_links)

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Ops (onboarding)
Redwood Inference

From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@quickmed.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@quickmed.io, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier activation: privacy & PO checklist for QuickMed pilot

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and attached the subprocessor export as requested.

- DPA: We reviewed Redwood's standard DPA link and would prefer QuickMed's signed DPA; we can provide a countersigned copy if you send your counterpart signature page.
- Subprocessors: attached QuickMed-Subprocessors.csv (columns: name, provider, purpose, country, contact). We have two cloud vendors in EU and one analytics provider in US.
- Data retention: For the pilot we retain logs for 90 days and account artifacts for 2 years; we can negotiate a shorter window for pilot data if required.
- Billing: procurement@quickmed.io is the billing contact; we use DocuSign for SOW/PO signature.

Attachments: QuickMed-Subprocessors.csv

Lara Chen
Vendor Ops Lead
QuickMed

Hi Lara —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the subprocessors CSV, that helps. A few follow-ups from the privacy intake side: 

1) Can you confirm whether any of the subprocessors process patient-identifiable information (PHI)? If yes, we'll need the business justification and the SOC2 + HIPAA addendum for those vendors.
2) For the 90-day log retention: is that logs for debug/observability only or does that include conversation transcripts / user content? For pilot scope we prefer transcripts removed after 30 days unless otherwise consented.
3) Please paste the legal entity exact name and VAT/Tax ID in reply so we can populate contract fields.

We can accept a countersigned signature page for the DPA — either DocuSign or a PDF with signature is fine. Once we have the tax/legal details and confirmation on PHI, I will run this through our privacy checklist and issue a go/no-go to finance.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior Privacy Manager
Redwood Inference

Quick answers to the points Monica raised:

- PHI: QuickMed does not plan to send PHI to Redwood for the pilot; transcripts will be anonymized. We will confirm final data samples by 2027-02-18.
- Retention: we can reduce transcript retention to 30 days for the pilot and provide a deletion request flow.
- Legal name / tax: QuickMed, Inc.; EIN 12-3456789; registered in Delaware.
- DPA signing: we'll run DocuSign today and return a countersigned signature page by end of day.

Attached: QuickMed-SOW-v1.pdf (draft SOW for pilot — please review, especially section 3 on data handling).
